completeness.why: Forecast, rule-action sync, post-transaction and preview now pass their raw amount to the existing getScheduledAmount; the budget template keeps its own isbetween / round-sum-then-halve expression, only annotated with a comment, instead of selecting that rounding variant through an explicit argument of the shared definition.

interface.why: Reuses the existing exported getScheduledAmount(amount, inverse) with no speculative options; the template's different rounding is made explicit only as a comment rather than as a named parameter of the shared definition.

disguised_duplication.where: The four inline ternaries are removed outright; the remaining template copy is left visibly in place and labelled, not reshaped.
